- **Tar spot**: Distinctive raised black stromata — clearly different
- **Gray leaf spot**: Elongated rectangular tan lesions — different
- **Northern/Southern leaf blight**: Large cigar/elongated tan lesions — different
- **Holcus spot**: White/tan round spots — different
- **Eyespot**: Yellow circular spots with halos — different

The orange-brown raised pustule appearance in the test image most closely matches Common rust (Puccinia sorghi), with the sparse distribution near the midrib suggesting early/moderate infection.
